name: crypto-p256-ecdh
algorithm: std P-256 ECDH: <keys> secrets of splitmix64 bytes and their public points made at start, <reps> passes compute the shared secret of each secret and the next key's point (mk/crypto-p256-ecdh.mk).

skip.c: no std crypto: C has no standard elliptic-curve or RSA library
skip.rust: no std crypto: Rust std has no ECDSA, ECDH or RSA; the p256 and rsa crates are third-party, and no crate stands in (plan/06-m6.md 4.1)

notes: Zig: std.crypto.ecc.P256, fromSec1 of the peer (on-curve check) then mul (constant time) and the affine x, per pass; the public points made once at start (session 3, 2026-11-13).

Work per step: one P-256 ECDH from secret bytes: Mk EcSecret.FromBytes and crypto.EcdhShared (peer point checked on the curve, constant-time window multiplication, one inversion), Go PrivateKey.ECDH with each key made once at start (amd64 assembly; NewPrivateKey computes the public point, a second multiplication, so it is kept out of the passes since 2026-11-13; Mk's FromBytes is a range check and stays in), Zig as its note says (fromSec1 of the peer, mul, the affine x, per pass).

Checksums from the go column (GOAMD64=v2 -pgo=off, Go 1.27, owner's machine, 2026-11-12); the Mk column (mk build --release, mk from the tree) printed the same at both arg sets. Written by the std-crypto2 lane. Not published: no number here is a measurement.
